svg.title: Pulse Architecture
svg.desc: A declarative estate YAML is validated and rendered by the pulse CLI into a read-only config tree, which the stack-core engine consumes to run a monitoring stack; a web overview aggregates the engine sources and agent-kit teaches an AI agent to operate the estate.
